title: Load sheet: landing CG when the fuel arm moves as the tanks drain
why_hard: Takeoff is within limits (29.6% MAC). Burning fuel that sits forward of the zero-fuel CG walks the CG aft, and because the fuel arm changes with quantity the landing CG reaches 32.6% MAC, past the 32.0% aft limit. A constant fuel arm (the ramp value) gives 31.05% MAC: wrongly 'in limits'.
failure_cost: Landing aft of the CG envelope reduces longitudinal stability and pitch-control margin in the flare.
sources: FAA-H-8083-1B, Aircraft Weight and Balance Handbook (fuel moment tables, %MAC)
